en: A vintage black‑and‑white seaside scene showing a crowded sandy beach and promenade with stairs and lamp posts, breakwaters in the Black Sea, and many bathers. The reverse has printed Romanian text identifying the place as Eforie‑Sud – Plaja, a 40‑bani POSTA ROMANA stamp commemorating the 1864–1964 centenary of the University of Bucharest with Alexandru Ioan Cuza, and postmarks from Eforie‑Sud and București. A handwritten Romanian message dated 27 iulie 1965 addresses someone in Bucharest.
